notes: Easy way to start earning service hours. Board meetings are at the Main Library.
name: Fullerton Library Teen Volunteer and Teen Advisory Board
what_you_do: Join the Teen Advisory Board to plan library programs and events. Or write book reviews for the library website. Each Board meeting you attend earns 1 hour of volunteer service. So does each approved review.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Earns volunteer service hours (1 hour per meeting or approved review).
duration: Board meets on the first and third Tuesday of each month at 6 p.m. (starting Sept 1, 2026)
deadline_text: No deadline. The Board needs no registration or application, so you can come to a meeting.
how_to_apply: Attend a Teen Advisory Board meeting or submit a book review. The Board needs no registration or application. Allow up to 7 business days after an activity for your credit to show. Call (714) 773-5719.
